bio: An auberge perched high on a tranquil plateau. The name is a mashup of ‘sens’ and ‘vie’, ‘sense’ and ‘life’, intended to convey the bounty of Nara’s land and the richness of its culture. Beautifully presented, modern cooking crystallises ideas born of dialogue with the food producers, potters and woodworkers of Nara who work with the restaurant. Sensibility thriving amidst the refreshing, lush natural beauty of the Yamato plain.
